Likely_Cause: Trailer never dispatched / closed in WMS (ghost stock), or the truck is still in the yard
Action: Find the trailer (Trucks & TTAT); dispatch / close it in WMS, or unload it if still loaded

Likely_Cause: Received but not put away, or the receipt was never confirmed
Action: Put away from the receiving lane, or correct / close the receipt

Likely_Cause: Picked and staged but never loaded (order cancelled, short-shipped or truck missed)
Action: Load on the next truck or return to storage; check the shipment status

Likely_Cause: Left on a production-line location (not consumed / not returned)
Action: Consume, return to storage or adjust at the line

Likely_Cause: Slow mover, FIFO not followed, or blocked / QA stock awaiting a decision
Action: Check FIFO rotation and obsolescence; get the release or disposal decision for blocked / QA stock
